/bin/bash -lc "GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off go test ./persistence -ginkgo.focus='loads an upgraded album' -ginkgo.no-color; git diff --stat; grep -R -n -E 'ExternalInfoUpdatedAt|ExpiresAt|LastVisitedAt|ImageFiles' --include='*.go' . | tail -100"
/bin/bash -lc 'GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off go test ./... > /tmp/navidrome-go-test.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -90 /tmp/navidrome-go-test.log; exit "$result"'

/bin/bash -lc 'GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off go test ./persistence ./utils/gg ./core ./core/artwork ./scanner ./server/subsonic ./server/public -count=1 > /tmp/navidrome-relevant-test.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -45 /tmp/navidrome-relevant-test.log; exit "$result"'

/bin/bash -lc 'GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off go test ./... > /tmp/navidrome-go-test-final.log 2>&1; result=$?; grep -E '"'"'^FAIL|''^--- FAIL|''^ok  |''^'"\\?' /tmp/navidrome-go-test-final.log | tail -35; exit \""'$result"'
